instructions: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland was written by Lewis Carroll, first published in 1865.
Alice falls down a rabbit hole into a world of riddles and strange characters -- a foundational work of literary nonsense, playful with language and logic.
Discussion prompt: Logic & Nonsense is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
